title.zh: Cohere发Embed 5：Pro建索引、Fast查询，不用重建向量库
title.en: Cohere发Embed 5：Pro建索引、Fast查询，不用重建向量库

current_state.zh: Cohere launched Embed 5, a multimodal embedding model line with Pro and Fast tiers that share a single vector space, letting enterprises index documents with Pro and serve queries with the cheaper Fast model without rebuilding their vector store.
current_state.en: Cohere launched Embed 5, a multimodal embedding model line with Pro and Fast tiers that share a single vector space, letting enterprises index documents with Pro and serve queries with the cheaper Fast model without rebuilding their vector store.
